# Commit Message Convention

RUSTALK follows the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) specification.

## Format

```
<type>(<scope>): <subject>

<body>

<footer>
```

## Types

- **feat**: A new feature
- **fix**: A bug fix
- **docs**: Documentation only changes
- **style**: Changes that do not affect the meaning of the code (white-space, formatting, etc)
- **refactor**: A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- **perf**: A code change that improves performance
- **test**: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests
- **chore**: Changes to the build process or auxiliary tools and libraries

## Scopes

Use these scopes to indicate which part of the codebase is affected:

- **frontend**: SvelteKit frontend changes
- **backend**: Rust backend changes
- **sip**: SIP protocol implementation
- **audio**: Audio infrastructure
- **rtp**: RTP/media handling
- **storage**: Credential storage
- **arch**: Architecture/structure changes
- **test**: Testing infrastructure
- **ci**: CI/CD changes
- **docs**: Documentation changes

## Examples

### Feature

```
feat(sip): implement SIP registration

- Add SipClient trait
- Implement rsip-based registration
- Add credential validation
- Support TLS/SIPS
```

### Bug Fix

```
fix(audio): resolve CoreAudio device enumeration crash

- Handle nil device case
- Add error logging
- Update device manager tests

Fixes RUST-123
```

### Breaking Change

```
feat(backend)!: change call state enum structure

BREAKING CHANGE: CallState enum now uses different variant names.
Migration required for existing state handling code.

- Rename Idle -> NotStarted
- Add Terminating state
- Update state machine transitions
```

## Body Guidelines

- Use the body to explain **what** and **why** (not how)
- Reference Linear issues: `Closes RUST-XXX`, `Fixes RUST-XXX`, `Relates to RUST-XXX`
- List major changes as bullet points
- Keep lines under 72 characters

## Footer

Use the footer for:

- Breaking change notices
- Linear issue references
- Co-authored-by credits

## AI-Generated Commits

All commits generated by AI agents should include:

```
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
